npcs.tooLowLine: Those wolves are a pest, get rid of them!

teachings.line: Adventurer! We need your help. Wolves prowl in the forrest nearby.
The city needs to hear about those wolf attacks! Take this, so you can find your way here.

lines: The city must hear of those wolves. Head east and report to the militia.

teachings.line: If Adventuring becomes too stressful, there is always farming!

lines: Tend to the field if you have time... or go out there adventuring. I know what I would pick.

npcs.tooLowLine: See off a wolf or two first, adventurer — mending is learned in the thick of it.

teachings.line: Let me show you how to tend to those wounds...
Let me show you how to tend to the wounds of your allies...

lines: Us hermits keep the old ways — there are more of us out there, if you look.
Something big prowls the dark forest.

teachings.line: Oh, all alone out here? Here, take this.

lines: The dark is only dark until you carry your own light.

npcs.tooLowLine: Careful! The tunnel is dark and dangerous.

teachings.line: The tunnel is overrun! Take my Pickaxe, I have no use for it anymore.

lines: We need the Militia to clear this tunnel once and for all... They are so useless
Sorry, can't let you in, the Orcs are too close.
The village needs help you say? I will let the commander know.

npcs.tooLowLine: I see you have a long way ahead of you. But I also see much potential. Come back later.

teachings.line: Let me teach you how to aid your fallen comrades and bring them back to life.

lines: Rest by the fire and regain your strength.

npcs.tooLowLine: Careful, the Orc assault camp lies just south of here. This is no place for you yet.

teachings.line: You look strong! We could use your help in the war. Take this.

lines: The orcs hold the south passage. Nobody leaves this valley without going through them.

npcs.tooLowLine: I see great potential in you! Come back later and I might have something for you.

teachings.line: You look like you could use some help. Take this Totem to aid you.

lines: Let nature guide you. But also be aware of nature. It's complicated.
Don't go east, Bandits are watching the road. Better try the tunnel up north.

npcs.tooLowLine: Fire doesn't suffer the careless. Grow stronger, then come to my flame.

teachings.line: Something to light you the way.
Let the fire burn in others!

lines: They burned this forest to hide their camp. Fire remembers who feeds it.
